q: What do batch normalisation and dropout do?
key_points: batch norm normalises activations per mini-batch, stabilises and speeds training
layer norm normalises per sample (used in transformers)
dropout randomly zeroes neurons during training to reduce overfitting
both behave differently at train vs inference time

q: RNN vs LSTM vs GRU vs Transformer: how do they differ?
key_points: RNN: processes sequence step by step, vanishing gradients on long sequences
LSTM: gates (input, forget, output) + cell state keep long-term memory
transformer: self-attention over all tokens in parallel, better long-range, scales on GPUs
transformers dominate NLP now; RNNs still used for small/streaming tasks

q: What loss functions would you use for regression, binary, multi-class and multi-label problems?
key_points: class weights / focal loss for imbalance

q: How does object detection with YOLO work at a high level?
key_points: predicts bounding boxes, objectness and class scores on a grid/anchors
trade-off: speed vs accuracy compared with two-stage (Faster R-CNN)

q: Walk me through building an OCR pipeline for scanned documents.
key_points: text detection then recognition (Tesseract, or deep models like TrOCR/PaddleOCR)
today: vision-language models for complex layouts; measure character/field accuracy

q: What is data augmentation, and why does it help?
key_points: create varied training samples from existing ones
images: flips, crops, rotations, colour jitter
text: back-translation, synonym swap; audio: noise, time shift
must keep labels valid (e.g. don't flip digits like 6/9)

q: How did NLP move from bag-of-words and Word2Vec to transformers?
key_points: bag-of-words/TF-IDF: counts, no word order or meaning
Word2Vec/GloVe: dense static embeddings, one vector per word
LLMs: scaled decoder transformers pretrained on huge text

q: How would you build a sentiment analysis model today, and how would you evaluate it?
key_points: fine-tune a small transformer (DistilBERT/RoBERTa) for best accuracy
or zero/few-shot with an LLM for speed to market
handle sarcasm, domain language, class imbalance
evaluate: macro-F1, confusion matrix, error analysis on slices

q: What is topic modeling? Compare LDA with embedding-based approaches like BERTopic.
key_points: discover themes in a document collection without labels
LDA: documents are mixtures of topics, topics are word distributions
needs choosing number of topics, bag-of-words
evaluate with coherence scores and human review
